effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[On Play] You may suspend this Tamer.
[All Turns] When this Tamer becomes suspended, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if one of your Digimon has [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
